messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "you and your doctor should decide whether you will breastfeed"
set: ["you and your doctor should decide whether you will breastfeed", "you and your doctor should decide whether you will take this medicine", "doctor will decide what is right for you", "your doctor will watch you closely", "decide with healthcare provider whether to take medicine or breastfeed", "doctor will decide on starting dose", "doctor should review from time to time whether you still need it", "prescriber will watch how you respond", "tell your doctor if you are pregnant", "tell your doctor if you also use", "tell your doctor if you have diabetes", "tell your doctor if you have phenylketonuria", "call your doctor if you experience agitation", "do this unless your doctor tells you otherwise", "ask your doctor what is reasonable for you", "talk to your doctor if you develop symptoms"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
